_comment: THE ACTION CONTRACT. The agent may only choose from this list. It never writes a procedure. Every entry is advisory and diagnostic -- nothing here actuates anything, and plant protection stays with the DCS interlocks (Plan, scope note).

actions.text: Inform shift in-charge and log the deviation in the shift register
Check deaerator level and BFP suction pressure; start standby BFP if suction is adequate
Check differential pressure across the feed water strainer and plan a changeover
Check make-up water consumption rate and inspect furnace for audible steam leak from a safe position
Check coal hopper level and poke the hopper for bridging; verify coal moisture at the yard
Check both coal feeder running status and motor current at the panel
Verify feed control valve position feedback against demand at the panel
Request the latest coal lab report and compare calorific value against the feeder calibration
Check primary air damper position and PA fan current against the firing rate
Verify CBD and IBD valve positions locally; confirm against the last handover note
Compare current bed temperature and steam output against the same load point last month
Raise a work request to inspect heat transfer surfaces at the next planned shutdown
Cross-check drum level against the local gauge glass before acting on the transmitter
Prepare for manual feed control and keep the standby feed path available
Reduce load in consultation with the shift in-charge until the cause is identified
Verify the suspect instrument against a second indication before treating its reading as real
